name: NymVPN
author: megabyte0x
description: Control NymVPN from the Omarchy bar: live tunnel status, one-click connect/disconnect, 5-hop mixnet vs 2-hop WireGuard mode, LAN access toggle, and searchable flag-labelled entry/exit country pickers with an optional measured "Fastest" mode that pings nearby gateways and pins the lowest-latency route. A front-end for the official nym-vpnc CLI — setup: install the nym-vpnc CLI + nym-vpnd daemon and log in from a terminal (the plugin never handles your recovery phrase); full steps in the README.

barWidget.description: NymVPN tunnel status with a connect/disconnect control panel
